summary: Full E2E testing of ChurnSense completed. Backend (9/9 pytest) and Frontend (all pages, navigation, predict, batch, models, about) all pass. One minor environment note: frontend required a one-time supervisor restart because the dev server was serving a stale template HTML (old title 'Emergent | Fullstack App') prior to restart.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup') — consider lifespan handlers (non-blocking).
CORSMiddleware is added AFTER app.include_router(api); this still works but conventionally middleware should be registered before routes for clarity.
Model artifacts and ~1MB CSV are loaded at import time; acceptable for this app, but imports fail hard if artifacts are missing (by design).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints verified: /api/, /api/eda (7032 customers, 26.58% churn), /api/models (3 models, best=Logistic Regression), /api/features (4 numeric, 15 categorical, 19 defaults), /api/predict (High risk 83% with month-to-month + fiber + e-check), /api/predict/batch (summary.rows=20, csv present, 400 on missing cols), /api/predict/sample-csv (20 rows + header). Frontend verified: Overview KPIs/charts all present, nav routes work, Models page shows 3 rows + Best badge + CM updates on row click + chart-featimp, Predict renders probability/risk/5 drivers/action, Batch upload (sample.csv) renders summary (20/9/5/6) + table + download button, About shows 'Atharva Kshirsagar', footer 'Atharva Kshirsagar', no 'Made with Emergent' or emergent.sh in page body. Note: Contract select is Radix combobox (not native <select>); use click + option selection in future tests. Title bug was a stale-dev-server issue fixed by supervisorctl restart frontend.
